prompt:
Create one high-resolution polished UI design presentation board showing THREE complete MOBILE APP SCREENS side by side for Custra, a consumer complaint registration app. This is a static UI concept, not implementation. Use the attached actual Custra brand logo as the visual reference: preserve its distinctive blue-to-cyan folded C emblem and navy Custra wordmark, adapted into a compact horizontal lockup in each header, no tagline. Do not redesign the symbol. Straight-on flat crisp screen designs, not a perspective device photograph. White/offwhite board background, subtle pale blue-gray screen surfaces, generous clean gutters, small external titles Home, Products, Agent conversation. Three evenly sized tall screen frames, equivalent to 390 x 844 CSS pixels, with readable well-typeset text. High quality native-style product UI with accessible contrast, consistent thin line icons, restrained borders and radii, navy text and royal blue primary actions, teal/cyan quiet accents. Single friendly contemporary sans-serif, realistic mobile font sizes. No decorative illustration banners, gradients on page backgrounds, glowing effects, or excessive wasted space. Faint screen frame only, no heavy phone hardware or notches.

SCREEN 1 HOME: compact Custra logo top left, circular profile avatar top right. Title 'Something not working?' and supporting line 'Your details are saved. We’ll handle the registration.' Prominent full-width royal-blue button '+ Register a complaint' visible near top. Then heading 'Active complaints' and 'View all'. Two compact complaint cards: first TV icon, 'Living room TV', 'Screen won’t turn on', amber quiet status chip 'Choose appointment', metadata '#DEMO-1042 · 17 Oct', and clear text action 'Choose time →'. Second washing-machine icon, 'LG Washing machine', 'Water leaking during wash', calm blue status chip 'Registration in progress', metadata '#DEMO-1041 · 17 Oct', action 'View conversation →'. Next heading 'Upcoming appointment', a compact appointment row 'Mon, 19 Oct · 10–11 AM IST', 'Samsung Refrigerator', and 'View details →'. Small quiet label 'Demo: business support and appointments are simulated.' Fixed bottom navigation: Home, Products, Appointments; Home active with blue icon/text, other tabs neutral, all with labels.

SCREEN 2 PRODUCTS: same header logo/profile. Title 'Your products' with subtitle 'Everything you need, saved once.' Search field 'Search products or brands'. Then EXACTLY FOUR square product icon tiles per row, NOT two columns, with labels beneath. First row: '+ Add product' outlined tile, TV icon 'Living room TV', fridge icon 'Samsung Fridge', washing machine icon 'LG Washer'. Second row: phone icon 'Pixel Phone', microwave icon 'IFB Microwave', AC icon 'Bedroom AC', laptop icon 'Work Laptop'. Each label wraps to at most two lines, compact but readable. Use consistent friendly product-category illustrations on pale cool-neutral square tiles, mostly line-based with tiny restrained blue accents, no brand logos except header. The TV tile shows a small blue activity dot and separate small label 'Open complaint'. Below tile grid, a quiet helpful information row 'Select a product to view details or register a complaint.' Plenty of usable whitespace, no additional grid. Below that a small section 'Continue where you left off' with one compact row for Living room TV and 'View complaint →', visually subordinate to grid. Same bottom navigation with Products active. EXACT four equal columns is mandatory.

SCREEN 3 AGENT CONVERSATION: top compact Custra logo with profile icon, then back chevron and heading 'Living room TV', subtitle '#DEMO-1042 · Simulated business support'. A slim progress strip: 'Details shared' completed, 'Registered' completed, 'Appointment' current. The main area is a clear chat interface with message bubbles LEFT for 'Business support · simulated' on white and RIGHT for 'Custra · your agent' on very pale blue; explicit visible role labels, restrained bubble widths and aligned edges. Show 4 messages with readable text: Business 'What product needs service?' Custra 'A Samsung TV, saved as Living room TV.' Business 'What problem are you seeing?' Custra 'The screen stays black when switched on.' Then a small centered timestamp separator 'Just now', Business message 'Your demo complaint is registered. Please choose an appointment.' At bottom of chat a distinct slim success summary 'Complaint registered' with reference '#DEMO-1042' and a full-width blue 'Choose date & time' button. Small note 'Custra answers using your saved details.' NO user message composer, NO send button, NO fake input. Bottom navigation Home, Products, Appointments, Home active. Show this as a stable saved conversation, no typing indicator as the conversation step is complete.

All screen contents are fictional examples. Focus on effortless complaint registration and trustworthy clear next actions. Maintain consistent iconography and exact navigation labels across all three screens. Render the board large enough to inspect all three screens and their copy.
notes: Fictional sample content; not a running application.
Three related screens, not alternative visual directions.
Generated logo rendering is illustrative; implementation must use actual supplied brand asset.
